title: Firehall Gyro Bowls
shortDescription: Greek-spiced beef, rice, vegetables, and tzatziki
subtitle: Greek-spiced beef, rice, vegetables, and tzatziki
description: Seasoned ground beef is served over lemon rice with cucumber, tomato, onion, and cool tzatziki.

steps.title: Cook rice
steps.instruction: Cook rinsed rice in salted water, keeping the lid closed so steam finishes the grains.

steps.title: Season beef
steps.instruction: Mix beef with oregano, garlic, cumin, salt, and pepper before it reaches the hot pan.

steps.title: Dice vegetables
steps.instruction: Dice cucumber and tomatoes into small pieces; keep them chilled in separate pans.

steps.title: Brown beef
steps.instruction: Cook beef in a wide skillet, breaking up large pieces with a sturdy spoon.

steps.title: Drain fat
steps.instruction: Pour off excess fat carefully, leaving a thin coating so the spices do not scorch.

steps.title: Finish beef
steps.instruction: Add a splash of water and cook until no pink remains and the beef reaches 165°F.

steps.title: Season rice
steps.instruction: Fold lemon zest, lemon juice, and parsley into the hot rice without mashing it.

steps.title: Taste tzatziki
steps.instruction: Stir tzatziki and adjust with lemon; keep it cold rather than warming it.

steps.title: Hold safely
steps.instruction: Keep beef and rice covered above 140°F while toppings stay refrigerated.

steps.title: Assemble bowls
steps.instruction: Layer lemon rice, beef, vegetables, onion, and a spoonful of tzatziki in each bowl.

steps.title: Hold for call interruptions
steps.instruction: If tones drop mid-cook: turn off direct heat and cover the seasoned ground beef — hold at 140°F in a warm cabinet or 200°F oven, never below 140°F for more than 30 minutes cumulative. Log hold time on the pan with a grease pencil. Keep the tzatziki cold the entire time — never move it toward the heat to warm it, that's what breaks the sauce. On return, spot-check the beef at a safe internal temp before reopening the line.

steps.title: Pack down leftovers safely
steps.instruction: Cool Lean ground beef and hot components in shallow hotel pans within two hours — deep pots stay in the danger zone too long. Label with date; reheat proteins to 165°F minimum before second shift. Store cold components separately so textures survive overnight.

proTips: Drain watery tomatoes before setting them out.
Offer feta separately for salt control.
Warm pitas are optional alongside bowls.
tonightSpread: Set hot components closest to the crew; cold crunch and toppings at the far end of the line.
Keep a backup tray at 200°F for firefighters returning from a run.
leftovers: Cool Lean ground beef in shallow pans within two hours; label with date and reheat to 165°F before second shift.
Store cold sides separately — hot and cold stacked overnight ruins texture.
Stuff leftover beef into breakfast wraps.
whyCrewsLikeIt: Crew members can control sauces and fresh toppings while the hot base stays in one pan.
mealPrepNotes: Make-ahead: chop vegetables and mix tzatziki 1 day ahead. Storage: refrigerate beef and rice for 3 days. Reheating: reheat beef to 165°F.
